text:
noah: Quick check 4aa: lunchtime bouldering meetup today? Found a tiny crag route behind the building with a couple of problems. Low-key.
anya: Ooh yes. What time? Can I bring my pads?
carlos: I can snag a crash pad and a brush. Which grade are the problems?
mia: I'm rusty but down for easy routes. Also can do a 20-min couch-to-crag warmup.
noah: Two obvious lines: slab slab (V0-V1) and little overhang (V2). Plan: meet 12:15, warmup 12:20-12:30, then work the problems.
club-bot: Reminder: outdoor climbing on company property requires spotter and pad. Safety checklist: pad, spotter, clear landing, first aid kit.
anya: I'll be spotter and bring a small first aid kit.
carlos: Bringing chalk, brush, pad. Mia want me to scale down the overhang holds? I'll tape the edges.
mia: Thanks! Also can someone demo footwork tips quick? Haven't trained edges in a while.
noah: I can demo foot smear and heel hook variations. Keep it social. No rope or lead, just boulder.
carlos: FYI: ops asked to avoid the west planter and not block the service walkway. We'll keep gear tight.
anya: If anyone's driving, can we stash gear in conference room F and grab after?
noah: Good call. I'll drop pad at conf F at 11:55.
mia: Rain check: light drizzle forecast at 12:40. If it sprinkles we can move to Gym Corner B for traverse board practice.
club-bot: Current headcount: 4. Ops sign-off not required for <5.
carlos: See you at 12:15!
anya: See you 60a
